_comment: Per-pipeline RAG registry (D255: 'separate RAGs for separate pipelines, different folders per project — think like an engineer'). Each pipeline = its own store dir + digest dir + source list. Shared CODE (fetchers, browser head, store), isolated DATA. Consumers (topic picking) read ONLY their own pipeline dir.

pipelines.name: islamic_daily
pipelines.fetcher: daily.py (existing — channel-1's feed = the general news store; scenario beats come from here)
pipelines.notes: General news = channel-1 scenario source. When Islamic-specific sources are added (fetch_islamic.py), they append into the SAME store — channel 1 is the general-news pipeline by design.

pipelines.name: pradhana_kerala
pipelines.notes: Kerala/Malayalam-specific news (D254). ISOLATED store — never mixed with the general store. Digest = what topic-picking reads.

pipelines.name: football
pipelines.notes: Match-DRIVEN, not daily: on demand per picked match (OPEN_ITEMS 3.1). understat xG/shot JSON -> data/<match_id>.json. fbref = fallback if understat changes layout.
